description: grade_text 金标集。来源：旧项目 essay_basic 教师必抓 + 三轮模型实测的 38 句学习者语料。匹配口径见 golden_eval.py（normalize 后双向子串）。
matching: must_catch 中的片段与某条 detection.original 在 normalize（小写、去非字母数字）后互为子串即算命中。

buckets.hard: 拼写/语法等确定错误，must_catch 应被命中
buckets.chinglish: 中式英语/不地道，must_catch 应被命中
buckets.soft: 语法可接受/看尺度：允许 suggestion，但报 error 算过度批改
buckets.ok: 地道且语法正确（含高级语法陷阱）：任何 detection 都算误报

cases.text: I is a student. I very like apple. Because it is delicious so I eat it every day. He don't like banana.
cases.note: 旧项目 essay_basic，多句整篇，教师列出的必抓点

cases.text: I go to school yesterday.
He like playing football.
cases.note: 三单：like→likes（锚点取最小公共词 like）

cases.text: I have two cat.
She is a honest girl.
I recieve your letter.
cases.note: 拼写：receive（本地拼写库也应抓）

cases.text: Please open the light.
You should eat medicine on time.
I very like this movie.
cases.note: very 不能这样修饰动词

cases.text: Although he is poor, but he is happy.
Because I was ill, so I didn't go to school.
cases.note: because/so 连用（锚点取最小公共词 so，模型取前半/后半都算命中）

cases.text: I am very agree with you.
We can learn many knowledges from books.
The street was people mountain people sea.
My hometown took place great changes.
cases.note: 句式：great changes took place in...

cases.text: In my opinion, I think we should start now.
I'd been looking forward to the trip, and it turned out even better than I expected.
Could you tell me where the nearest subway station is?
She has been working on the project since last Monday.
My English is poor.
cases.note: 经典中式：not very good / not fluent

cases.text: Can you say it again? I didn't listen clearly.
Studying abroad is a good chance to open our eyes.
The restaurant's environment is very good and the food is delicious.
How to say this word in English?
cases.note: 完整问句：How do you say...

cases.text: His English level is very high.
We played very happily at the park yesterday.
With the development of society, more and more people buy cars.
cases.note: 中式套话（难题，pro 复测曾漏）

cases.text: I have something to do tomorrow, so I can't make it.
cases.note: 基本可接受，不该判 error

cases.text: I think it's not a good idea.
cases.note: 否定前移更自然，但原句不算错

cases.text: No need to be so polite.
cases.note: 看语境可接受，不该判 error

cases.text: Please give me some advice on how to learn English well.
I go to school by bike every day. It is very convenient.
Don't worry, let me help you to solve this problem.
cases.note: help sb (to) do 都对，不该判错

cases.text: Long time no see! How have you been?
I'd appreciate it if you could let me know by Friday.
That movie was so good I watched it twice.
There's no way I'm going to finish this on time.
She suggested that he see a doctor right away.
cases.note: 虚拟语气原形 see，勿改 sees

cases.text: I'm used to getting up early these days.
cases.note: be used to + doing，正确，勿改 get up
